threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look puzzled when the barista asks for your 'name' but it's really just a cue for your drink to come out cold.
Caught the N87 last weekend; a bloke was serenading the whole bus with 80s hits like he was auditioning for a talent show. Bizarrely uplifting.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The morning after the BVG strike, I saw a guy in full tuxedo waiting for the bus, looking ready for a wedding that wasn't happening. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg can you find a late-night Späti serving currywurst and cocktails, all while a DJ spins vinyl in the corner. It’s bizarrely Berlin.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: If they know where to find the best pupusas at 9 PM after a night out, they’re a local. Tourists are still hunting for burritos.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Last week, a dog decided the Civic Center station was its personal playground, while everyone else just waited, bewildered. Classic Muni.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all of Gràcia is for partying. Most locals avoid the rambles of pubs; we gather at quiet plaça to sip our café amb llet.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their struggle with the Metro ticket machines—pushing buttons like they're doing a puzzle, while everyone else just breezes through.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a warm pint in a tin can is a good idea. The locals are eyeing your choice like it’s a crime against humanity.
Caught the 68 last night; a bloke was loudly arguing with his reflection in the window. Weirdly, we all got silent, like we were in on his madness.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Walking past the Turkish market on a Sunday, I caught the scent of roasted chestnuts mixing with the sound of a street musician—it hit me then, this is home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Ever notice how the U-Bahn stations here have vintage ads that feel like stepping back in time? It's a living museum under our feet.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows that the best tacos are from the stand by the BART entrance, not the shiny new joint everyone raves about.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy trying to feed a feral cat from his Muni transfer while the bus rattled over a pothole. Only in SF do you see cat lovers multi-tasking like that.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just all about Gaudí. They miss the real charm in the little plazas where locals gather for a quiet evening.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their insistence on calling it "La Rambla," not realizing it’s just "Rambla" for locals. Always dropping the definite article.
